title: Gió qua đồng cỏ
about: Round x10, for sleep with improvised melodies (style ngu-ngon), as the user asked to go on ("ok chúng ta hãy tiếp tục sáng tác nhạc"), on the sounds the user liked most: a soft wind over a moor at night, the pad and a deep sub, the glass improvising like lights far off. B minor. No drums, plucked string or organ. An original piece; its melody made up by the improviser in dark/ambient.py.
